titel: Click Joints (gratis add-on) op Printables: nieuw hoofdbeeld met figuur en kogelgewricht (issue #297)
rol: You 3D print at home and sometimes model or sculpt your own figures in Blender. You are browsing Printables, searching for 'ball joint' and 'blender addon', to find something that helps you make poseable, jointed prints. You see the main image of each model in the search results and decide which one you click and download first.
